name: vault
description: Your Obsidian vault (S3 bucket or local folder) as Claude's persistent memory: indexed search, session-start context, a repo log with commit shas, and lint.

vault_path.title: Local vault folder
vault_path.description: Absolute path to a vault on this machine. Leave empty to use S3.

s3_endpoint.title: S3 endpoint
s3_endpoint.description: e.g. https://minio.example.com (leave empty when using a local folder)

s3_bucket.title: S3 bucket
s3_bucket.description: Bucket that holds the vault (e.g. obsidian)

s3_access_key.title: S3 access key
s3_access_key.description: Access key with read/write on the bucket

s3_secret_key.title: S3 secret key
s3_secret_key.description: Secret key for that access key
